Choose an algebraic space <MATH_0001> and a morphism
<MATH_0002> which is surjective, flat, and locally of finite
presentation. By the discussion above the composition
<MATH_0003> is also surjective, flat, and locally of finite
presentation. Denote
<MATH_0004>.
By
Lemma <REF_0001>
we see that <MATH_0005> has <MATH_0006> if and only if <MATH_0007> does
and that <MATH_0008> has <MATH_0009> if and only
if <MATH_0010> does. The lemma follows.
